cases.scenario: Base commit = $6.3M with a symmetric forecast confidence band of +/-14%. Compute the downside scenario revenue as the band lower bound = commit x (1 - band). State the single figure in $M to three decimals.
cases.source: Three-scenario construction: downside = forecast commit-band lower bound = commit x (1 - band_pct) (standard base/upside/downside modeling; NOT an arbitrary base x 0.8).

check.rationale: 6.3 x (1 - 0.14) = 6.3 x 0.86 = 5.418 ($M). Step 1: downside = O2 commit-band lower bound.
